title: 同步輻射儲存環~Synchrotron storage rings
focus: 每圈能量損失、MBA 發射度、磁鐵公差、射頻接受度、Touschek 壽命與頂注~Energy loss per turn, MBA emittance, magnet tolerances, RF acceptance, Touschek lifetime and top-up
summary: 以一座 3 GeV、528 m 的教學用多彎消色散儲存環為主線，從同步輻射造成的每圈 430 keV 能量損失出發，說明發射度為何隨彎轉角三次方下降，再把小孔徑磁鐵、射頻補能、束流尺寸量測、Touschek 壽命、插件磁鐵擾動與頂注驗收整合成可交接的光源工程紀錄。~Follow a 3 GeV, 528 m teaching multi-bend-achromat storage ring from the 430 keV per-turn energy loss caused by synchrotron radiation, see why emittance falls with the cube of the bending angle, then integrate small-bore magnets, RF energy replacement, beam-size measurement, Touschek lifetime, insertion-device perturbations and top-up acceptance into a transferable light-source engineering record.

units.anchor: 彎轉磁鐵與輻射光錐~Bending magnet and radiation cone
units.title: 同步輻射、每圈能量損失與臨界能量~Synchrotron radiation, energy loss per turn and critical energy
units.mechanism: 儲存環讓數 GeV 的電子在磁場中持續偏轉，相對論電子偏轉時沿切線方向放出張角約 1/γ 的同步輻射光錐，每一圈損失的能量 U₀ 必須由射頻腔補回。U₀ 與 E⁴/ρ 成正比，這是電子而非質子適合當光源的原因；輻射頻譜以臨界能量 εc 描述，一半功率在 εc 以上、一半在以下。輻射同時是阻尼機制：能量沿動量方向損失、射頻只在縱向補回，使振盪逐漸衰減，並與量子激發的隨機擾動達成平衡，決定環的平衡發射度與能量散佈。~A storage ring keeps electrons of several GeV bending in magnetic fields, and relativistic electrons emit synchrotron radiation tangentially in a cone of opening about 1/γ; the energy U0 lost each turn must be restored by RF cavities. U0 scales as E⁴/ρ, which is why electrons rather than protons make light sources, and the spectrum is described by the critical energy εc, with half the power above it and half below. Radiation is also a damping mechanism: energy is lost along the momentum direction but replaced by RF only longitudinally, so oscillations decay until balanced by the random kicks of quantum excitation, which sets the ring's equilibrium emittance and energy spread.
units.model: E = 3 GeV、彎轉場 B = 0.6 T：ρ = 3.3356×3/0.6 ≈ 16.7 m，U₀ = 88.5×3⁴/16.7 ≈ 430 keV，500 mA 時輻射功率 U₀·I ≈ 215 kW；εc = 0.665×3²×0.6 ≈ 3.59 keV。周長 528 m、迴轉週期 T₀ = 1.76 µs，阻尼時間 τ = 2E·T₀/(J·U₀)：縱向（J ≈ 2）約 12.3 ms、水平（J ≈ 1）約 24.6 ms；自然能量散佈 σδ = γ√(C_q/(2ρ)) ≈ 6.3×10⁻⁴。~For E = 3 GeV and a bending field B = 0.6 T, ρ = 3.3356×3/0.6 ≈ 16.7 m and U0 = 88.5×3⁴/16.7 ≈ 430 keV, so at 500 mA the radiated power U0·I ≈ 215 kW; εc = 0.665×3²×0.6 ≈ 3.59 keV. With a 528 m circumference the revolution period is T0 = 1.76 µs and the damping time τ = 2E·T0/(J·U0) is about 12.3 ms longitudinally (J ≈ 2) and 24.6 ms horizontally (J ≈ 1); the natural energy spread is σδ = γ√(C_q/(2ρ)) ≈ 6.3×10⁻⁴.
units.verify: 以射頻順向功率與腔壓讀數量測不同儲存電流下的束流功率，斜率即為每圈損失 U₀（扣除插件磁鐵貢獻後）；以光束線的光通量對能量曲線擬合臨界能量，並以條紋相機或束流頻譜量同步振盪頻率，與由 U₀ 推算的同步相位比對。~Measure beam power from RF forward-power and cavity-voltage readings at several stored currents; the slope gives the energy loss per turn U0 once insertion-device contributions are removed. Fit the critical energy to a beamline's flux-versus-energy curve, and measure the synchrotron oscillation frequency with a streak camera or the beam spectrum to compare with the synchronous phase predicted from U0.
units.failure: 只用彎轉磁鐵估 U₀ 而漏算插件磁鐵，射頻電壓與功率留得太緊；所有插件磁鐵關閉間隙後同步相位上移、能量接受度下降，Touschek 壽命突然縮短，甚至在注入時掉束。~Estimating U0 from the dipoles alone and forgetting insertion devices leaves too little RF voltage and power; when all insertion devices close their gaps the synchronous phase rises, energy acceptance shrinks, and Touschek lifetime suddenly drops or beam is lost at injection.
units.misconception: 儲存環的電子以固定能量循環，不需要持續補充能量。~Stored electrons circulate at fixed energy and need no continuous energy input.

units.anchor: 多彎消色散晶胞~Multi-bend achromat cell
units.title: 發射度標度律與多彎消色散晶格~Emittance scaling and multi-bend achromat lattices
units.mechanism: 水平發射度 ε 是電子束位置與角度分佈的相空間面積，決定光源亮度與同調度。量子激發發生在色散不為零的彎轉磁鐵內，因此每片磁鐵的彎轉角 θ 越小、色散函數越小，發射度越低；理論最小值（TME）與 γ²θ³ 成正比。第三代光源每個晶胞只用兩片彎轉磁鐵（DBA），第四代改用五到七片（MBA），在同一周長中把磁鐵數提高到約 3 倍，發射度因 θ³ 降低一個數量級以上，代價是更強的四極與六極磁鐵、更小的動態孔徑與更困難的注入。~The horizontal emittance ε is the phase-space area of the electron beam's position and angle distribution and sets source brightness and coherence. Quantum excitation occurs in dipoles where dispersion is non-zero, so a smaller bending angle θ per magnet and smaller dispersion give lower emittance; the theoretical minimum (TME) scales as γ²θ³. Third-generation rings use two dipoles per cell (DBA), while fourth-generation rings use five to seven (MBA), roughly tripling the dipole count in the same circumference and cutting emittance by more than an order of magnitude through θ³, at the price of stronger quadrupoles and sextupoles, a smaller dynamic aperture and harder injection.
units.model: TME 極限 ε_min = C_q·γ²·θ³/(12√15·J_x)，C_q = 3.83×10⁻¹³ m、γ = 5871。24 晶胞 DBA（48 片，θ = 0.131 rad）：ε_min ≈ 637 pm；20 晶胞 7BA（140 片，θ = 0.0449 rad）：ε_min ≈ 25.7 pm，比值 (140/48)³ ≈ 24.8。實際晶格受動態孔徑限制，通常落在理論值的數倍，取 4 倍約 100 pm；1 Å X 光的繞射極限 λ/4π ≈ 8 pm。~The TME limit is ε_min = C_q·γ²·θ³/(12√15·J_x) with C_q = 3.83×10⁻¹³ m and γ = 5871. A 24-cell DBA (48 dipoles, θ = 0.131 rad) gives ε_min ≈ 637 pm; a 20-cell 7BA (140 dipoles, θ = 0.0449 rad) gives ε_min ≈ 25.7 pm, a ratio (140/48)³ ≈ 24.8. Real lattices are limited by dynamic aperture and usually sit several times above the limit; taking a factor of 4 gives about 100 pm, compared with the diffraction limit λ/4π ≈ 8 pm for 1 Å X-rays.
units.verify: 以晶格程式（如 MAD-X、Elegant、AT）計算線性光學與發射度，再追蹤粒子求動態孔徑與動量接受度；試運轉時以響應矩陣分析（LOCO 類方法）反推實際四極強度與色散，並用光源點尺寸量測反推發射度，三者必須互相一致。~Compute linear optics and emittance with a lattice code such as MAD-X, Elegant or AT, then track particles to obtain dynamic aperture and momentum acceptance; during commissioning infer actual quadrupole strengths and dispersion with response-matrix analysis (LOCO-type methods) and emittance from source-size measurements, and require all three to agree.
units.failure: 為了追求最低發射度把晶格推到極限，六極磁鐵強度過大，動態孔徑只剩數毫米，注入效率長期偏低且對磁鐵誤差極敏感；機器可以達到設計發射度，卻無法穩定做頂注運轉。~Pushing the lattice to its limit for the lowest emittance needs sextupoles so strong that dynamic aperture shrinks to a few millimetres, leaving injection efficiency chronically low and very sensitive to magnet errors; the machine reaches design emittance but cannot sustain top-up operation.
units.misconception: 只要把彎轉磁鐵做得更強，發射度就會變小。~Making the bending magnets stronger lowers the emittance.

units.anchor: 小孔徑四極磁鐵與磁鐵座~Small-bore quadrupoles and girders
units.title: 磁鐵孔徑、梯度與對準公差~Magnet bore, gradient and alignment tolerances
units.mechanism: MBA 晶格要求 50 T/m 以上的四極梯度與很強的六極，鐵芯磁極尖端磁場 B_tip = G·r 必須低於鐵的飽和（設計上約 1 T 以下較安全），因此只能縮小孔徑；孔徑縮小又讓所需安匝數按 r² 下降，磁鐵更小、更省電，但真空管只剩約 20 mm 內徑。磁鐵以數十微米精度預先對準在共同的磁鐵座上，再整座安裝；四極磁鐵偏離束流中心 Δx 時會給電子一個偏轉 θ = K₁L·Δx，經閉合軌道放大後，整圈軌道都會偏移。~MBA lattices need quadrupole gradients above 50 T/m and very strong sextupoles, and the iron pole-tip field B_tip = G·r must stay below saturation, safely under about 1 T, so the bore must shrink; a smaller bore also cuts the required ampere-turns as r², making magnets smaller and cheaper to power, but leaves only about 20 mm inner diameter for the vacuum chamber. Magnets are pre-aligned to tens of micrometres on common girders that are installed as units; a quadrupole offset Δx from the beam axis gives the electrons a kick θ = K1L·Δx that the closed orbit amplifies around the whole ring.
units.model: 每極安匝 NI = G·r²/(2μ₀)：G = 50 T/m、r = 12.5 mm 時 NI ≈ 3110 A·turn、B_tip = 0.625 T；若 r = 35 mm，NI ≈ 24 400 A·turn（7.8 倍，功耗約 61 倍），且 B_tip = 1.75 T 已超過鐵的飽和。偏移：Bρ = 10.0 T·m、L = 0.25 m，K₁L ≈ 1.25 m⁻¹，Δx = 30 µm 產生 37.5 µrad；兩處 β = 5 m、工作點 ν = 42.2 時閉合軌道最大偏移 ≈ β/(2|sin πν|)×θ ≈ 4.25 m×37.5 µrad ≈ 159 µm。~Ampere-turns per pole are NI = G·r²/(2μ0): with G = 50 T/m and r = 12.5 mm, NI ≈ 3110 A·turn and B_tip = 0.625 T; at r = 35 mm, NI ≈ 24 400 A·turn (7.8 times, about 61 times the power) and B_tip = 1.75 T is beyond iron saturation. Offset: with Bρ = 10.0 T·m and L = 0.25 m, K1L ≈ 1.25 m⁻¹, so Δx = 30 µm gives 37.5 µrad; with β = 5 m at both locations and tune ν = 42.2, the peak closed-orbit shift ≈ β/(2|sin πν|)×θ ≈ 4.25 m×37.5 µrad ≈ 159 µm.
units.verify: 磁鐵出廠時以旋轉線圈或拉伸線量測梯度、多極成分與磁中心，記錄磁中心相對機械基準的偏差；上座後以雷射追蹤儀量磁鐵座相對位置；運轉時以束流基準對準（調變單一四極強度、找出軌道不變的位置）反推每個四極相對 BPM 的偏移。~At the factory, measure gradient, multipole content and magnetic center with a rotating coil or stretched wire, and record the magnetic center relative to mechanical fiducials; after mounting, survey girder positions with a laser tracker; in operation, use beam-based alignment, modulating one quadrupole and finding where the orbit stops changing, to infer each quadrupole's offset from its BPM.
units.failure: 磁鐵座安裝在溫度尚未穩定的混凝土地板上，地板隨季節與日照緩慢變形，數十微米的漂移累積成數百微米的軌道偏差；軌道回授雖能補正，但修正子強度逐月爬升，最終耗盡修正範圍。~Girders installed on concrete that has not reached thermal equilibrium drift with seasons and sunlight; tens of micrometres of movement accumulate into hundreds of micrometres of orbit error, and although orbit feedback compensates, corrector strengths creep upward month by month until their range is exhausted.
units.misconception: 磁鐵孔徑越大越好，因為可以容納更多束流。~A larger magnet bore is always better because it accommodates more beam.

units.anchor: 射頻腔與高功率放大器~RF cavities and high-power amplifiers
units.title: 射頻系統：補回 U₀、同步相位與 RF 接受度~RF system: replacing U0, synchronous phase and RF acceptance
units.mechanism: 射頻腔以迴轉頻率整數倍（諧波數 h）的電場加速電子，同步電子每次通過剛好拿回 U₀，相位滿足 eV·sin φs = U₀。早到與晚到的電子拿到不同能量，在色散造成的路徑差下繞同步點做縱向同步振盪，形成束團；腔壓相對 U₀ 的過電壓比 q 決定 RF 桶的高度，也就是可容許的能量偏差。射頻功率除了供給束流損失，還要支付腔壁的歐姆損耗，並隨插件磁鐵間隙改變而變動，因此低階射頻控制（LLRF）必須穩住振幅與相位。~RF cavities accelerate electrons with a field at an integer multiple h of the revolution frequency, and the synchronous electron regains exactly U0 each pass at a phase satisfying eV·sin φs = U0. Early and late electrons gain different energies and, through the path-length difference caused by dispersion, perform longitudinal synchrotron oscillations about the synchronous point, forming bunches; the overvoltage ratio q of cavity voltage to U0 sets the height of the RF bucket, the tolerable energy deviation. RF power must cover the beam loss plus cavity wall losses and changes as insertion-device gaps move, so the low-level RF control must hold amplitude and phase steady.
units.model: 528 m、100 MHz：h = 176。U₀ = 430 keV（彎轉）+ 200 keV（插件）= 0.63 MeV，腔壓 V = 1.6 MV：q = 2.54，φs = arcsin(1/q) ≈ 23.2°。動量壓縮 α_c = 3×10⁻⁴ 時 RF 接受度 δ = √[(2U₀/(πα_c hE))·(√(q² − 1) − arccos(1/q))] ≈ 5.4%，同步頻率 f_s = f_rev·√(hα_c eV cos φs/(2πE)) ≈ 1.15 kHz。功率：束流 0.63 MV×0.5 A = 315 kW，六個腔各 R_s = 3 MΩ 的壁損 6×(0.267 MV)²/(2×3 MΩ) ≈ 71 kW，共約 386 kW。~For 528 m and 100 MHz, h = 176. With U0 = 430 keV from dipoles plus 200 keV from insertion devices, 0.63 MeV, and V = 1.6 MV, q = 2.54 and φs = arcsin(1/q) ≈ 23.2°. With momentum compaction α_c = 3×10⁻⁴ the RF acceptance δ = √[(2U0/(πα_c hE))·(√(q² − 1) − arccos(1/q))] ≈ 5.4%, and the synchrotron frequency f_s = f_rev·√(hα_c eV cos φs/(2πE)) ≈ 1.15 kHz. Power: beam 0.63 MV×0.5 A = 315 kW plus wall losses of six cavities with R_s = 3 MΩ, 6×(0.267 MV)²/(2×3 MΩ) ≈ 71 kW, about 386 kW in total.
units.verify: 以束流頻譜分析儀量同步頻率旁帶並換算腔壓與 φs，與 LLRF 的腔壓讀數比對；逐步降低腔壓直到壽命開始下降，判斷實際接受度由射頻還是由晶格動量接受度限制；高功率端記錄順向與反射功率、腔體溫度與調諧器位置。~Measure the synchrotron-frequency sidebands with a beam spectrum analyser and convert them to cavity voltage and φs, comparing with the LLRF voltage readings; lower the voltage step by step until lifetime begins to fall to find whether acceptance is limited by the RF or by the lattice momentum acceptance; on the high-power side log forward and reflected power, cavity temperatures and tuner positions.
units.failure: 高電流下腔體的束流負載使腔壓相位偏移，若調諧與 LLRF 前饋不足，會激發耦合束團不穩定，束團長度與能量散佈週期性跳動，光束線看到強度與光點位置在 kHz 頻段抖動。~At high current, beam loading shifts cavity voltage and phase; with insufficient tuning and LLRF feedforward, coupled-bunch instabilities develop, bunch length and energy spread oscillate, and beamlines see intensity and spot-position jitter in the kilohertz band.
units.misconception: 腔壓剛好等於 U₀ 就足以維持束流。~A cavity voltage exactly equal to U0 is enough to keep the beam.

units.anchor: X 光針孔相機與光源點~X-ray pinhole camera and source point
units.title: 束流尺寸量測與發射度反推~Beam-size measurement and emittance inversion
units.mechanism: 發射度無法直接量，只能從某處的束流尺寸反推：σ = √(β·ε + (η·σδ)²)，其中 β 與色散 η 來自晶格量測，σδ 來自能量散佈量測。MBA 環的垂直尺寸只有數微米，可見光成像受繞射限制而失效，必須用 X 光針孔相機、繞射式成像或同步光干涉儀。量到的是束流尺寸與儀器點擴散函數（PSF）的捲積，因此 PSF 的校正誤差會直接放大成發射度誤差，尤其當束流尺寸與 PSF 相當時。~Emittance cannot be measured directly; it is inferred from a beam size somewhere through σ = √(β·ε + (η·σδ)²), with β and dispersion η from lattice measurements and σδ from energy-spread measurement. Vertical sizes in an MBA ring are only a few micrometres, beyond diffraction-limited visible-light imaging, so X-ray pinhole cameras, diffractive imaging or synchrotron-light interferometers are used. The measured value is the beam size convolved with the instrument point-spread function (PSF), so PSF calibration error is amplified directly into emittance error, especially when beam size and PSF are comparable.
units.model: 光源點 β_x = 1 m、η = 5 mm、ε_x = 100 pm、σδ = 6.3×10⁻⁴：σ_x = √(1×10⁻¹⁰ + (3.15×10⁻⁶)²) ≈ 10.5 µm；若忽略色散項，反推 ε ≈ 110 pm，高估 10%。垂直 β_y = 3 m、ε_y = 5 pm：σ_y ≈ 3.87 µm；PSF 3.0 µm 時量得 √(3.87² + 3²) ≈ 4.90 µm，PSF 不確定 ±0.5 µm 造成 σ_y 誤差 3×0.5/3.87 ≈ 0.39 µm（10%），ε_y 誤差約 20%。~At a source point with β_x = 1 m, η = 5 mm, ε_x = 100 pm and σδ = 6.3×10⁻⁴, σ_x = √(1×10⁻¹⁰ + (3.15×10⁻⁶)²) ≈ 10.5 µm; ignoring the dispersion term would infer ε ≈ 110 pm, 10% high. Vertically, β_y = 3 m and ε_y = 5 pm give σ_y ≈ 3.87 µm; with a 3.0 µm PSF the measured size is √(3.87² + 3²) ≈ 4.90 µm, and a ±0.5 µm PSF uncertainty produces a σ_y error of 3×0.5/3.87 ≈ 0.39 µm (10%), about 20% in ε_y.
units.verify: 在兩個 β 或 η 不同的光源點同時量測，聯立解出 ε 與 σδ；PSF 以改變針孔尺寸或用已知的小尺寸光源校正；再以斜四極調整耦合改變 ε_y，確認量到的尺寸變化與模型一致，並與 Touschek 壽命隨 ε_y 的變化交叉驗證。~Measure simultaneously at two source points with different β or η and solve jointly for ε and σδ; calibrate the PSF by changing pinhole size or using a known small source; then change ε_y with skew quadrupoles and confirm that the measured size change follows the model, cross-checking against the variation of Touschek lifetime with ε_y.
units.failure: 針孔相機的閃爍屏或像素尺度沒有重新校正，PSF 被低估，系統回報的垂直發射度只有真實值的一半，操作人員據此判斷耦合已最小化，實際光束線的光點與同調度卻達不到預期。~If the pinhole camera's scintillator or pixel scale is not recalibrated, the PSF is underestimated and the reported vertical emittance comes out half the true value; operators conclude coupling is minimized while beamline spot size and coherence fall short of expectations.
units.misconception: 拍到的光點寬度就是束流尺寸，不需要扣除儀器響應。~The width of the imaged spot is the beam size, with no need to remove the instrument response.

units.anchor: 壽命監測與諧波腔~Lifetime monitor and harmonic cavity
units.title: 束流壽命：Touschek 散射、殘氣與誤差預算~Beam lifetime: Touschek scattering, residual gas and the error budget
units.mechanism: 儲存電流以多種機制慢慢流失。Touschek 散射是同一束團內兩顆電子碰撞，把橫向動量轉成縱向，使能量偏差超過動量接受度而損失；束團越密（發射度越小、束團越短）損失越快，因此低發射度環的壽命往往由 Touschek 主導。殘氣散射與真空壓力成正比，新安裝的真空腔要經過數百安培小時的束流清洗，讓光子誘發脫附下降。第三諧波腔把束團拉長數倍以降低電子密度，是 MBA 環延長壽命的標準手段。~Stored current leaks away by several mechanisms. Touschek scattering is a collision between two electrons in the same bunch that converts transverse momentum into longitudinal, pushing the energy deviation beyond the momentum acceptance; the denser the bunch, with smaller emittance and shorter length, the faster the loss, so low-emittance rings are usually Touschek-dominated. Residual-gas scattering scales with vacuum pressure, and new chambers need hundreds of ampere-hours of beam conditioning to reduce photon-stimulated desorption. A third-harmonic cavity lengthens the bunch several times to lower electron density and is the standard way to extend lifetime in MBA rings.
units.model: 總壽命 1/τ = 1/τ_T + 1/τ_gas。束長 10 ps 時 τ_T = 6 h（教學假設），殘氣 τ_gas = 40 h：τ ≈ 5.2 h；諧波腔拉長到 40 ps 使 τ_T（∝ σ_s）變為 24 h：τ = 1/(1/24 + 1/40) = 15 h。若晶格動量接受度從 3% 降到 2.5%，τ_T 約按接受度三次方縮為 24×0.58 ≈ 13.9 h，總壽命降到約 10.3 h。~Total lifetime obeys 1/τ = 1/τ_T + 1/τ_gas. With a 10 ps bunch, τ_T = 6 h (teaching assumption) and τ_gas = 40 h give τ ≈ 5.2 h; a harmonic cavity stretching bunches to 40 ps raises τ_T (∝ σ_s) to 24 h and τ = 1/(1/24 + 1/40) = 15 h. If lattice momentum acceptance falls from 3% to 2.5%, τ_T shrinks roughly as the cube of acceptance to 24×0.58 ≈ 13.9 h and total lifetime to about 10.3 h.
units.verify: 以 DCCT 量電流衰減率求壽命，並在總電流不變下改變束團填充模式（每束團電荷不同）以分離 Touschek 與殘氣項：Touschek 項隨每束團電荷變化，殘氣項只隨壓力變化；再以腔壓掃描與垂直耦合掃描確認壽命對接受度與 ε_y 的依存。~Derive lifetime from the DCCT current-decay rate, and separate Touschek and gas terms by changing the fill pattern at constant total current: the Touschek term varies with charge per bunch, the gas term only with pressure; then scan RF voltage and vertical coupling to confirm the dependence of lifetime on acceptance and ε_y.
units.failure: 插件磁鐵或真空元件更換後未經充分束流清洗，局部壓力升高一個數量級，殘氣壽命從 40 h 掉到 4 h；散射電子同時在下游窄縫處提高輻射劑量，並帶來波盪器磁鐵永久退磁的風險。~After replacing an insertion device or vacuum component without enough beam conditioning, local pressure rises an order of magnitude and gas lifetime drops from 40 h to 4 h, while scattered electrons raise radiation dose at downstream narrow apertures and risk permanent demagnetization of undulator magnets.
units.misconception: 發射度越低，束流壽命一定越長。~Lower emittance always gives longer beam lifetime.

units.anchor: 波盪器間隙與前饋表~Undulator gap and feedforward tables
units.title: 插件磁鐵整合：光子能量、環的負擔與擾動~Insertion-device integration: photon energy, ring load and perturbations
units.mechanism: 儲存環的主要光源是直線段中的插件磁鐵：波盪器以週期 λu 的交錯磁場讓電子小幅蛇行，輻射在特定波長干涉增強，光子能量以間隙調整 K 值；扭擺器則以強場產生寬頻、高功率的輻射。每支插件磁鐵都是環的一部分：它增加每圈能量損失與射頻負擔，產生垂直聚焦而改變工作點，磁場積分誤差在間隙變動時擾動軌道，因此每支插件磁鐵都要附帶以間隙為索引的修正子與四極前饋表。~A storage ring's main sources are insertion devices in the straights: an undulator's alternating field of period λu makes electrons snake gently so radiation interferes constructively at specific wavelengths, with photon energy tuned by gap through K; a wiggler uses strong fields for broadband, high-power radiation. Each device becomes part of the ring: it adds energy loss per turn and RF load, produces vertical focusing that shifts the tune, and its field-integral errors disturb the orbit as the gap moves, so every insertion device carries gap-indexed corrector and quadrupole feedforward tables.
units.model: λu = 2.0 cm、B₀ = 0.8 T：K = 0.934×0.8×2.0 ≈ 1.49，基頻 E₁ = 0.950×3²/(2.0×(1 + K²/2)) ≈ 2.02 keV，第 5 諧波約 10.1 keV。3 m 長的能量損失 U_ID = 0.633·E²·B₀²·L ≈ 10.9 keV，500 mA 時 5.5 kW 打到前端；十支共 109 keV，加兩支 2 T、2 m 扭擺器各 45.6 keV，合計約 200 keV。垂直聚焦 k_y = 1/(2ρ₀²)，ρ₀ = 10.0/0.8 ≈ 12.5 m，β_y = 3 m 時 Δν_y = β_y·k_y·L/(4π) ≈ 0.0023。~For λu = 2.0 cm and B0 = 0.8 T, K = 0.934×0.8×2.0 ≈ 1.49 and the fundamental E1 = 0.950×3²/(2.0×(1 + K²/2)) ≈ 2.02 keV, with the fifth harmonic near 10.1 keV. A 3 m device loses U_ID = 0.633·E²·B0²·L ≈ 10.9 keV, sending 5.5 kW onto the front end at 500 mA; ten of them total 109 keV, and two 2 T, 2 m wigglers add 45.6 keV each, about 200 keV in all. Vertical focusing k_y = 1/(2ρ0²) with ρ0 = 10.0/0.8 ≈ 12.5 m gives Δν_y = β_y·k_y·L/(4π) ≈ 0.0023 for β_y = 3 m.
units.verify: 在儲存束流下逐步掃描間隙，同時記錄全環軌道、工作點與射頻功率，建立修正子與四極前饋表；驗收時要求間隙全程移動下軌道擾動小於束流尺寸的 10%，光束線則以單色器掃描諧波峰位置，確認 K 值與電子能量。~Scan the gap step by step with stored beam while logging the ring-wide orbit, tunes and RF power to build corrector and quadrupole feedforward tables; acceptance requires the orbit disturbance over full gap travel to stay below 10% of the beam size, and the beamline scans harmonic peaks with its monochromator to confirm K and electron energy.
units.failure: 新裝真空內波盪器的前饋表只在低電流下建立，高電流時阻抗與熱負載改變，間隙移動造成數微米的軌道跳動傳到其他光束線，使用者看到光點在別人調能量時跳動。~A new in-vacuum undulator whose feedforward table was built only at low current behaves differently at high current, where impedance and heat load change; gap moves then kick the orbit by several micrometres, and users on other beamlines see their spot jump whenever someone else changes energy.
units.misconception: 插件磁鐵只影響自己的光束線，不影響其他使用者。~An insertion device affects only its own beamline, not other users.

units.anchor: 頂注注入與驗收紀錄~Top-up injection and acceptance record
units.title: 頂注運轉、注入效率與試運轉驗收~Top-up operation, injection efficiency and commissioning acceptance
units.mechanism: 現代光源以頂注運轉讓儲存電流幾乎恆定：增能環每隔幾分鐘把少量電荷注入環中，補回壽命損失，光束線的熱負載因此穩定，光學元件不必隨電流漂移重新對準。MBA 環的動態孔徑小，傳統以四支踢波磁鐵造凸軌的離軸注入很難不擾動儲存束流，因此發展出多極注入踢波器或軸上交換注入。由於注入時光束線光閘保持開啟，注入效率必須夠高，損失電荷要控制在輻射安全允許範圍內，這是頂注能否放行的核心驗收項目。~Modern light sources run in top-up mode to keep stored current nearly constant: every few minutes the booster injects a little charge to replace lifetime losses, so beamline heat loads stay steady and optics need no realignment as current drifts. MBA rings have small dynamic apertures, so classic off-axis injection with a four-kicker bump is hard to do without disturbing the stored beam, leading to multipole injection kickers or on-axis swap-out. Because beamline shutters stay open during injection, efficiency must be high and lost charge must stay within radiation-safety limits, which is the core acceptance item for allowing top-up.
units.model: I = 500 mA、τ = 15 h：電流每小時下降 500/15 ≈ 33.3 mA；要維持 ±0.5%（2.5 mA）需每 2.5/33.3 h ≈ 4.5 分鐘注入一次。環內 500 mA 對應 I·T₀ = 0.5×1.76 µs ≈ 0.88 µC，2.5 mA 對應 4.4 nC；注入效率 90% 時每次需送入 4.9 nC、損失 0.49 nC，每小時累積約 6.5 nC 打在環內，這個數字決定屏蔽與劑量監測的設計。~With I = 500 mA and τ = 15 h, current falls 500/15 ≈ 33.3 mA per hour; holding ±0.5% (2.5 mA) requires an injection every 2.5/33.3 h ≈ 4.5 minutes. The stored 500 mA is I·T0 = 0.5×1.76 µs ≈ 0.88 µC, and 2.5 mA corresponds to 4.4 nC; at 90% efficiency each top-up must deliver 4.9 nC and loses 0.49 nC, about 6.5 nC per hour deposited in the ring, a figure that drives shielding and dose-monitoring design.
units.verify: 試運轉驗收依序確認：儲存電流與壽命達標、發射度與耦合量測、軌道穩定度小於束流尺寸 10%、注入效率的統計分佈與每次注入對儲存束流的擾動（以逐圈 BPM 記錄）；再以劑量計確認損失位置與量，最後交接操作參數、前饋表與異常處理紀錄。~Commissioning acceptance confirms in order: stored current and lifetime on target, measured emittance and coupling, orbit stability below 10% of beam size, the statistical distribution of injection efficiency and the disturbance of each injection on the stored beam recorded by turn-by-turn BPMs; dosimeters then confirm where and how much charge is lost, and operating parameters, feedforward tables and fault records are handed over.
units.failure: 注入踢波磁鐵的脈衝波形不匹配，每次頂注時儲存束流在數百圈內振盪數十微米；電流雖然穩定，對時間敏感的實驗卻每 4.5 分鐘出現一次壞數據。若注入效率逐漸下降而未察覺，損失電荷增加會觸發輻射連鎖，使頂注中止。~Mismatched injection-kicker pulse shapes make the stored beam oscillate tens of micrometres for hundreds of turns at every top-up, so although current is steady, time-sensitive experiments record bad data every 4.5 minutes; if injection efficiency slowly falls unnoticed, the growing lost charge trips radiation interlocks and stops top-up.
units.misconception: 頂注只是讓電流穩定，對光束線使用者沒有其他影響。~Top-up merely keeps the current steady and has no other effect on beamline users.

example: 晶格升級練習：同一條 528 m、3 GeV 的隧道，比較 24 晶胞 DBA（48 片彎轉磁鐵，每片 1.4 m）與 20 晶胞 7BA（140 片，總彎轉長度 104.8 m）。DBA：ρ = 48×1.4/(2π) ≈ 10.7 m、B ≈ 0.94 T、U₀ = 88.5×81/10.7 ≈ 670 keV、εc ≈ 5.6 keV、τ_x = 2E·T₀/U₀ ≈ 15.8 ms，TME 極限 637 pm。7BA：ρ = 16.7 m、B = 0.6 T、U₀ ≈ 430 keV、εc ≈ 3.59 keV、τ_x ≈ 24.6 ms，TME 極限 25.7 pm。500 mA 下彎轉磁鐵輻射功率從 335 kW 降到 215 kW，射頻負擔減輕，但阻尼變慢、εc 變低，硬 X 光改由插件磁鐵提供。若兩者實際發射度都約為 TME 的 4 倍（2.55 nm 對 103 pm），垂直發射度相同，則加上 1 Å 光子的 8 pm 後，水平有效光源發射度從 2.56 nm 降到 111 pm，波盪器亮度約提高 23 倍。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際設施規格。~Lattice upgrade exercise: in the same 528 m, 3 GeV tunnel compare a 24-cell DBA (48 dipoles of 1.4 m) with a 20-cell 7BA (140 dipoles, 104.8 m of total bending length). DBA: ρ = 48×1.4/(2π) ≈ 10.7 m, B ≈ 0.94 T, U0 = 88.5×81/10.7 ≈ 670 keV, εc ≈ 5.6 keV, τ_x = 2E·T0/U0 ≈ 15.8 ms and a TME limit of 637 pm. 7BA: ρ = 16.7 m, B = 0.6 T, U0 ≈ 430 keV, εc ≈ 3.59 keV, τ_x ≈ 24.6 ms and a TME limit of 25.7 pm. At 500 mA the dipole radiation power falls from 335 kW to 215 kW, easing the RF load, but damping slows and εc drops, so hard X-rays must come from insertion devices. If both lattices reach about 4 times their TME limit (2.55 nm versus 103 pm) with equal vertical emittance, adding the 8 pm photon term at 1 Å gives a horizontal effective source emittance falling from 2.56 nm to 111 pm, raising undulator brightness about 23-fold. Values are teaching assumptions, not any facility's specification.
history: 1947 年 GE 的 70 MeV 同步加速器首次觀察到同步輻射；1960 至 70 年代同步光先寄生於高能物理環，1968 年 Tantalus 成為第一座專用儲存環。1990 年代 ESRF、APS、SPring-8 與台灣 TLS 等第三代光源以插件磁鐵為主角；2016 年 MAX IV 3 GeV 環首次以多彎消色散晶格把發射度降到數百 pm，ESRF-EBS 於 2020 年把混合多彎晶格帶進 6 GeV 高能環。本課只重建公開物理與工程邏輯。~In 1947 synchrotron radiation was first observed at a 70 MeV General Electric synchrotron; in the 1960s and 1970s it was used parasitically on high-energy-physics rings, and Tantalus became the first dedicated storage ring in 1968. Third-generation sources of the 1990s, including ESRF, APS, SPring-8 and Taiwan's TLS, made insertion devices the main sources. In 2016 the 3 GeV MAX IV ring was the first to use a multi-bend achromat to reach emittances of a few hundred picometres, and ESRF-EBS brought a hybrid multi-bend lattice to a 6 GeV ring in 2020. This course reconstructs only public physics and engineering logic.
